method.data: flow_3s Bybit linear, Lake.read_asof per symbol with column projection at a fixed as_of; complete 3 s grid; candles missing (collector gaps) or without a valid book (mid / spread null) are not ok and never zero-filled; lags and ACFs never cross a gap
method.classes: major = BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB, DOGE; tradfi = instrument symbol_type in ETF/stock/commodity or the TradFi stream list (incl. XAUT, PAXG); alt = the rest
method.H-SIM1: live mm quotes (orderLinkId 'mm...', deduplicated across the 5 pulls by orderId) with at-risk candles [created, cancel) or [created, fill candle]; usable when >= 95% of at-risk weight is in the lake, the fill candle is present and the 60 s markout mid is known; train = first half of usable quotes by creation time, test = second half; MLE of (theta0, b, eps) per variant (touch / strict); primary variant = lower train AIC; predicted fill rate = compensator sum of hazards / quotes; predicted markout = hazard-weighted; observed CIs: 30-min block bootstrap of the test half (B = 2000); markout = side * (mid at the close of the candle 60 s after the fill candle - quote price) / price in bps
method.H-SIM3: per symbol-day OLS of y = signed taker notional / day median depth_25 on lagged returns (sigma units; lags 1, 2-5, 6-20), obi_5, flow lags and recent vol; intensity log(1+trades) on lagged log spread, vol and activity lags; momentum = b1 + 4 b2 + 15 b3; 5-minute clock clusters; sign stability = share of symbol-days with the modal sign for each primary response (momentum, obi, spread); equality: per symbol pooled over days, stacked cluster influence across symbols, Wald H0 equal (momentum, obi, spread) within class; supports = all three sign shares >= 0.80 and no rejection at 5% in >= 2 of 3 classes; symbol-days with < 2000 usable 3 s rows dropped
method.H-SIM2: generator (sim/flow_sim.py) fitted per symbol on 2026-11-08 + 2026-11-09, 10 paths of the 2026-11-10 ok-candle count each; facts: excess kurtosis of 3 s mid returns, mean ACF of |r| lags 1-60, mean ACF of signed flow lags 1-20, standardised impact slope corr(r_t, F_t), spread median and p90 (both must pass); class value = median over symbols (sim: of each symbol's median over paths); envelope = [min over the 3 real days of the 2.5% bootstrap quantile, max of the 97.5%] of the class median, 1 h block bootstrap within each symbol-day (B = 300); supports = >= 4 of 5 facts inside for every class; contradicts = some class has <= 2 inside
method.H-SIM4: atx mm quote rule ported (sim/replay.py) with config/mm_multi.yaml values, one symbol at a time, decisions every 3 candles (9 s), no structural levels; grid ask {0.2, 0.45, 0.9} x bid {0.2, 0.45, 0.9} x take-profit {0.3, 0.9} x requote {0.15, 0.5} sigma = 36 sets; replay on the real 2026-11-10 paths of the mm_multi symbols (warm-up from earlier candles) with the H-SIM1 primary fill model, 3 fill seeds; simulator: the H-SIM2 model of each symbol, 3 paths of the same ok-candle count, same fill model; metric = pooled net P&L / turnover (bps) per parameter set; Spearman of the 36 rankings, bootstrap over symbols (B = 2000); supports = rho > 0.5 with the 95% CI excluding 0
method.fees: maker 2 bps, taker 5.5 bps; market orders pay half-spread + 10 bps * sqrt(notional / depth_25)

storage_estimate.text:
The v0 bottlenecks are (1) the fill model sees candles, not queues; (2) 23 held-out live fills; (3) three gappy days. Proposed v1 data, for the user to decide (storage budget 30 GB, lake today 0.84 GB):

| item | scope | estimate for 4 weeks |
|---|---|---|
| raw trades (trades_raw: ts, side, price, size, id) | the 50 mm_multi symbols, 7.6 M prints/day at 25 B/print (measured on BTC trades_raw) | 5.3 GB |
| L2 book deltas (orderbook.50 or .200 updates, levels within 25-100 bp) | 12 representative symbols (4 majors, 4 alts, 4 TradFi: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, XRPUSDT, HYPEUSDT, ENAUSDT, MAVIAUSDT, WIFUSDT, TSLAUSDT, NVDAUSDT, XAUUSDT, CLUSDT), 5.6 M update messages/day (the collector's book_updates count) at an assumed 40-120 B/message | 6.3-19.0 GB |
| flow_3s as today (all symbols) | ongoing, 0.16 GB/day | 4.5 GB |
| total incl. the current lake | | 17-30 GB |

With raw trades and book deltas the fill model can track queue position (our size vs the size ahead at our price, depletion by prints at that price, cancels), the generator can be a proper marked Hawkes on events instead of 3 s aggregates, and reaction functions can be estimated on event time. The book-delta byte cost is an assumption: measure it with a one-day pilot on 2-3 symbols before committing, and keep the deltas on a rolling retention (like trades_raw) after the derived features are stored. A further cheap gain: run the live quoter with a few deliberate parameter variants (paired, same symbols) to collect hundreds of fills per variant, which is what H-SIM1 and H-SIM4 lack most.
